answer: By bonding dynamic stake to a per-epoch identity atlas, the protocol prices each Sybil cluster as a distinct canyon of collateral that a sudden gale of registrations cannot cheaply flood. Cooperative subgame-perfect equilibria then reward peers who attest only to stake-backed identities, since duplicate keys collapse into one weighted slot under Byzantine quorum rules. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
